name: Time-delay starting or closing relay
summary: Introduces a deliberate interval before a starting or closing operation is permitted.
description: Introduces a deliberate interval before a starting or closing operation is permitted.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the initiating contact and timer supply. The associated drawing should trace the delayed start or close command; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the initiating contact and timer supply.
Trace the delayed start or close command.
drawingChecklist: Label the initiating contact and timer supply.
Cross-reference the delayed start or close command.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: Device 2 delays starting or closing; device 62 delays a stopping or opening action.
